title: Rav Akavya

paragraphs: At the end of Avodah Zarah, Rava says, “Who could be clever enough to do such a thing but Rav Akavya, a man of ability?” The Arukh and Tosafot, Shabbat 42b, read Rav Ukva or Mar Ukva. See also Tosafot on Nazir 53a.[^1][^2]

notes.text: “A man of ability” conveys the approving idiom דגברא הוא. Rav Ukva and Mar Ukva remain alternative readings attributed to the named works.

Hyman reports the Ukva readings in the Arukh and Tosafot. “A man of ability” is an interpretive rendering of דגברא הוא, literally “for he is a man”; the approving force is clear, but the English idiom is not a separate biographical claim.
